Yeah, absolutely. Well, as you know, I really wanted to serve on the Agriculture Committee. And I have been preparing for the discussion about the farm bill ever since I was named to the committee. What I did is I put together a working group of people from all across Minnesota to help me understand really well what Minnesota's priority should be for the farm bill because I realize it's much less a part of an issue than it is a regional issue and what matters to Minnesota. I've had quite a few meetings with farmers and commodity producers and um... talked with people at the university of minnesota extension and people who care a lot about rural development and also the nutrition programs and uh... coming out of these conversations i'm picking up a couple of too big things the first is that everybody is talking about how we need flexibility and kind of co-operation across the existing programs in the farm bill so that you know local folks can make make it work for them in their community And this is, I think, really important because we're not going to be a bunch of new money in the Farm Bill this year. So making sure that the money that we have to spend, we can use as well as we can. And then the second thing that people are talking about is there are kind of core programs in the Farm Bill that we really all need to go together and hold together. And certainly the big farm programs like crop insurance so important, especially right now, the sugar program, the dairy program, That's what got to keep those really working well. And then also rural development is crucial. Everyone is telling me and then the nutrition program because that's what helps. I mean, not only does it help people all over Minnesota and all over the country, but it also helps us to get support here in Washington DC.

Well, there has been some talk about this so-called harvest box in the house because the bill is being debated. They're working on the bill in the committee. in the house. And so this harvest box idea is just, I mean, it's just a bad idea. It is not efficient. It doesn't get our grandparents and our children who rely on nutrition assistance, the food that they need.
